name: Sikorsky S-92
summary: Large twin-engine helicopter used for offshore oil transport and SAR, and by the Marine Corps as the VH-92A presidential 'Marine One' helicopter.

wings: Four-blade main rotor with swept, drooped tips
engines: Two engines side by side on top of a tall cabin
fuselage: Tall, boxy airliner-like cabin with large square windows
Retractable tricycle gear with main wheels in side sponsons
Rear loading ramp under the tail
VH-92A: dark green with white top, Marine One livery
tail: Single-sided horizontal stabilizer high on the tail pylon

tellTales: Tall, boxy cabin with big square windows and sponsons for the wheels
Rear ramp under an upswept tail with a canted tail rotor
Stabilizer sticking out from one side only, high on the tail

confusedWith.howToTell: The Black Hawk is long and low with fixed gear and a tailwheel; the S-92 is tall and boxy with retractable gear in sponsons.
The AW139 has five blades and a lower, pointed nose; the S-92 has four blades on a much taller, boxier cabin with a rear ramp.
The S-76 is slim with a long pointed nose and no sponsons; the S-92 is bigger and boxier.
The S-61 has a five-blade rotor and a rounded boat-shaped hull; the S-92 has four blades and a boxy modern fuselage with a rear ramp.
The Super Puma has a longer boxy cabin and a deep, blunt nose; the S-92 has a rounded fuselage and a rear loading ramp.

usCount.source: FAA registry make/model inquiry (S-92A, ~49) + 23 VH-92A (USMC / Sikorsky)
